# Min and Max with the semantics of the Go built-ins ("Minimum and
# maximum"): a NaN operand gives NaN, -0 is less than +0, and equal
# operands give x canonicalized. The returned operand keeps its exponent.

# --- Min64 ---

Min64 - exact 3 2 -> 2
Min64 - exact -10 3 -> -10
Min64 - exact 1.0 1 -> 1.0
Min64 - exact 1 1.0 -> 1
Min64 - exact -1.0 -1 -> -1.0
Min64 - exact 1 2 -> 1
Min64 - exact 2.5 2.50 -> 2.5
Min64 - exact 1E+2 100 -> 1E+2
Min64 - exact 1E+2 99 -> 99
Min64 - exact -9.999999999999999E+384 1E+369 -> -9.999999999999999E+384
Min64 - exact 1.000000000000001 1 -> 1

Min64 - underflow 1E-398 2E-398 -> 1E-398
Min64 - underflow -1E-398 -2E-398 -> -2E-398
Min64 - underflow 1E-398 0 -> 0
Min64 - underflow -1E-398 -0 -> -1E-398

Min64 - zero 0 -0 -> -0
Min64 - zero -0 0 -> -0
Min64 - zero 0 0 -> 0
Min64 - zero -0 -0 -> -0
Min64 - zero 0.00 -0 -> -0
Min64 - zero -0E+5 0 -> -0E+5
Min64 - zero 0.00 0 -> 0.00
Min64 - zero 0 1E-398 -> 0
Min64 - zero -0 1 -> -0

Min64 - inf -Infinity 5 -> -Infinity
Min64 - inf Infinity 5 -> 5
Min64 - inf -Infinity -Infinity -> -Infinity
Min64 - inf Infinity -Infinity -> -Infinity
Min64 - inf 5 Infinity -> 5
Min64 - inf -Infinity -9.999999999999999E+384 -> -Infinity

Min64 - nan NaN 1 -> NaN
Min64 - nan 1 NaN -> NaN
Min64 - nan -NaN 1 -> NaN
Min64 - nan sNaN 1 -> NaN
Min64 - nan NaN NaN -> NaN
Min64 - nan -Infinity NaN -> NaN
Min64 - nan 0x7c00000000000001 1 -> NaN

Min64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff 1 -> 0
Min64 - noncanon 1 0x6c77ffffffffffff -> 0
Min64 - noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff 0 -> -0E+5
Min64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff 0x6c77ffffffffffff -> 0
Min64 - noncanon -1 0x6c7386f26fc10000 -> -1
Min64 - noncanon 0x6007ffffffffffff 1E-398 -> 0E-398

# --- Min128 ---

Min128 - exact 3 2 -> 2
Min128 - exact -10 3 -> -10
Min128 - exact 1.0 1 -> 1.0
Min128 - exact 1 1.0 -> 1
Min128 - exact -1.0 -1 -> -1.0
Min128 - exact -9.999999999999999999999999999999999E+6144 1 -> -9.999999999999999999999999999999999E+6144

Min128 - underflow 1E-6176 2E-6176 -> 1E-6176
Min128 - underflow -1E-6176 -2E-6176 -> -2E-6176

Min128 - zero 0 -0 -> -0
Min128 - zero -0 0 -> -0
Min128 - zero 0 0 -> 0
Min128 - zero 0.00 -0 -> -0
Min128 - zero -0E+5 0 -> -0E+5

Min128 - inf -Infinity 5 -> -Infinity
Min128 - inf Infinity 5 -> 5
Min128 - inf Infinity -Infinity -> -Infinity

Min128 - nan NaN 1 -> NaN
Min128 - nan 1 NaN -> NaN
Min128 - nan sNaN 1 -> NaN
Min128 - nan 0x7c000000000000010000000000000000 1 -> NaN

Min128 - noncanon 0x3041ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 1 -> 0
Min128 - noncanon 1 0x3041ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 -> 0
Min128 - noncanon 0xb047ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 0 -> -0E+3
Min128 - noncanon -1 0x6c100000000000000000000000000000 -> -1

# --- Max64 ---

Max64 - exact 3 2 -> 3
Max64 - exact -10 3 -> 3
Max64 - exact 1.0 1 -> 1.0
Max64 - exact 1 1.0 -> 1
Max64 - exact -1.0 -1 -> -1.0
Max64 - exact 1 2 -> 2
Max64 - exact 2.5 2.50 -> 2.5
Max64 - exact 1E+2 100 -> 1E+2
Max64 - exact 1E+2 101 -> 101
Max64 - exact 9.999999999999999E+384 1E+369 -> 9.999999999999999E+384
Max64 - exact 1.000000000000001 1 -> 1.000000000000001

Max64 - underflow 1E-398 2E-398 -> 2E-398
Max64 - underflow -1E-398 -2E-398 -> -1E-398
Max64 - underflow 1E-398 0 -> 1E-398
Max64 - underflow -1E-398 -0 -> -0

Max64 - zero -0 0 -> 0
Max64 - zero 0 -0 -> 0
Max64 - zero 0 0 -> 0
Max64 - zero -0 -0 -> -0
Max64 - zero 0.00 -0 -> 0.00
Max64 - zero -0 0E+5 -> 0E+5
Max64 - zero 0.00 0 -> 0.00
Max64 - zero 0 -1E-398 -> 0
Max64 - zero -0 1 -> 1

Max64 - inf Infinity 5 -> Infinity
Max64 - inf -Infinity 5 -> 5
Max64 - inf Infinity Infinity -> Infinity
Max64 - inf -Infinity Infinity -> Infinity
Max64 - inf 5 -Infinity -> 5
Max64 - inf Infinity 9.999999999999999E+384 -> Infinity

Max64 - nan 1 NaN -> NaN
Max64 - nan NaN 1 -> NaN
Max64 - nan 1 sNaN -> NaN
Max64 - nan -NaN 1 -> NaN
Max64 - nan NaN NaN -> NaN
Max64 - nan Infinity NaN -> NaN
Max64 - nan 1 0xfe0000000001e240 -> NaN

Max64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff -1 -> 0
Max64 - noncanon -1 0x6c77ffffffffffff -> 0
Max64 - noncanon 1 0x6c77ffffffffffff -> 1
Max64 - noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff -0 -> -0E+5
Max64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff 0x6c77ffffffffffff -> 0
Max64 - noncanon 0x77ffffffffffffff -0E+369 -> 0E+369

# --- Max128 ---

Max128 - exact 3 2 -> 3
Max128 - exact -10 3 -> 3
Max128 - exact 1.0 1 -> 1.0
Max128 - exact 1 1.0 -> 1
Max128 - exact -1.0 -1 -> -1.0
Max128 - exact 9.999999999999999999999999999999999E+6144 1 -> 9.999999999999999999999999999999999E+6144

Max128 - underflow 1E-6176 2E-6176 -> 2E-6176
Max128 - underflow -1E-6176 -2E-6176 -> -1E-6176

Max128 - zero -0 0 -> 0
Max128 - zero 0 -0 -> 0
Max128 - zero -0 -0 -> -0
Max128 - zero 0.00 -0 -> 0.00
Max128 - zero -0 0E+5 -> 0E+5

Max128 - inf Infinity 5 -> Infinity
Max128 - inf -Infinity 5 -> 5
Max128 - inf -Infinity Infinity -> Infinity

Max128 - nan 1 NaN -> NaN
Max128 - nan NaN 1 -> NaN
Max128 - nan 1 sNaN -> NaN
Max128 - nan 1 0xfe000000000000000000000000000005 -> NaN

Max128 - noncanon 0x3041ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 -1 -> 0
Max128 - noncanon 1 0x3041ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 -> 1
Max128 - noncanon 0xb047ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 -0 -> -0E+3
Max128 - noncanon 0x6c100000000000000000000000000000 0x3041ffffffffffffffffffffffffffff -> 0
